//: ettle hooks — see hooks/README.md. Merge into your Claude Code settings (~/.claude/settings.json for all projects, or a project's .claude/settings.json). Replace YOUR_ROOM everywhere with your room, and adjust the PostToolUse matcher to your Linear MCP server's tool prefix. horizon-hook injects the coordination knots relevant to you at session start; capture-hook distills THIS session and publishes your own atoms; pull-hook ingests teammates' Linear replies.
